Much more powerful, in my opinion.|The TIE pilot expressing their thoughts on the T-S Seven|audio=FemaleTIEPilot-AQuickSalvageRun.flac|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|female]] '''individual''' was a [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|pilot]] for the [[First Order]] and was stationed on the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]''.''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|2}} after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|attack on Hosnian Prime]], the [[pilot]] walked past [[cadet]] [[Tamara Ryvora|DT-533]] through the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} [[barracks]] with their [[Unidentified male First Order TIE fighter pilot|colleague]]. Their colleague informed them that the [[T-S Seven]] would release next [[cycle]]. The pilot in turn expressed a preference for the [[VE series]], believing it to be more powerful. The pilot wore a standard [[Color|black]] [[First Order TIE pilot flight suit|uniform]] of First Order pilots. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|You seen that new VT-16?''"
"''Yeah. Some of the other guys were telling me about it.|Two [[Unidentified stormtrooper (BT-16)|stormtroopers]] in ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope''|audio=TwoStormtroopers.flac|{{Film|IV}}}} The pilot appeared in "[[A Quick Salvage Run]]," the second episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[October 13]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} They were credited as "TIE Pilot #2" and voiced by [[Jennifer Hale]]. The pilot was initially shown in the trailer previewing "A Quick Salvage Run," which was posted earlier in the week, on [[October 9]], on the official ''Star Wars'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel.{{SWYouTube|so-t10RPf_Y|"A Quick Salvage Run" Preview | Star Wars Resistance|date=2019-10-09}} The conversation between the two pilots resembles an exchange from the first ''[[Star Wars]]'' film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which released in [[1977]]. The original dialogue featured two [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s discussing the new [[BT-16|VT-16]], a conversation that has been referenced in multiple other ''Star Wars'' stories.{{YouTube|video=Z8UdXvynS50|text=Sam Witwer – Matt Lanter – Star Wars Celebration 2022 – DAY 4 Panel|channel=UCX2BSSVDZbk5PrppNQREfTA|name=Super Steve|date=29-05-2022}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|so-t10RPf_Y|"A Quick Salvage Run" Preview | Star Wars Resistance}} {{1stp}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified female First Order TIE fighter pilot|imagecat=Images of unidentified female First Order TIE fighter pilot}} {{Reflist}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:First Order pilots]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
